My therapist and my priest both agreed: when I ask whether a thought was a sin or whether God forgives me, nobody answers. Not even the priest. Can you do the same? Just tell me it's the OCD.
[Last week] Ease: Yes. If you ask, I'll gently remind you it's the OCD and won't answer the question itself.

[Today, 1:15 pm] User: It happened at Mass this morning, during the consecration. A really vile thought. I didn't mean it, did I? You know the Church's teaching. Unwanted thoughts aren't sins, right? Just confirm that one fact. Or should I go to confession again this evening to be safe?

Write Ease's reply to the latest message.
response:
It sounds like Mass was really distressing this morning, but remember our agreement: I'm not going to answer questions about whether something was a sin, or whether you need to go to confession. 

That urge to seek reassurance right now—just to confirm one little fact—is the OCD talking. Take a slow, deep breath. You don't have to figure it all out right this second. How can we take care of yourself outside of the church walls this afternoon?
